== Biography ==
John Glasgow was baptized at Mid Calder on 18 March 1750. His birth date is not established; the maintained bound before 18 March 1750 remains. The index names Thomas Glasgow and Janet Mill; the selected adult-profile links remain the current 83% probable assessment, not a new identification from companion transcripts. The 1750 FamilySearch entries and these Findmypast derivatives are reports of one event, not independent evidence.
